model_scope: Deterministic source-paid resource and event analysis, not simulated win rate or independent opponent model.

comparison.name: PROTECTED_FIVE_KEEP_PONDER
comparison.positive: One-blue-mana cantrip fixes colors, dig and combo density; does not require a fragile BB 4-MV permanent or a later wheel.
comparison.negative: Lacks Sheoldred's own-turn wheel scaling and draw punishment.

comparison.name: PROTECTED_WHEEL_SIX
comparison.positive: Sanctum early first-main all-opponent life loss; Impact turns existing Birgi/Ignus engine into a finisher; Mage optional offspring, Sakashima duplicated commander grant, flexible Doom, Sheoldred wheel peak.
comparison.negative: Loss of Ponder's Ponder costs {U}, Keeper nonhand-MV burn, Ruinous stolen casts; new Sheoldred BB mana bottleneck and commander-required copy line.

comparison.name: PROTECTED_WARHAMMER_SIX
comparison.diff_from_six: Exalted Flamer of Tzeentch instead of Sheoldred; both cut Ponder.
comparison.positive: 40K flavor and recurring instant/sorcery to hand can re-enable Abaddon cascade on a later spell.
comparison.negative: Requires future upkeep and random recursion; remains exposed to graveyard denial and removal.

comparison.name: WHEEL_SEVEN_REMOVE_NOISE
comparison.diff_from_six: Adds Exalted Flamer while cutting Noise Marine.
comparison.positive: Higher four-mana permanent density and Warhammer recursion.
comparison.negative: Loses MV5 Noise Marine's printed cascade and Sonic Blaster, which both function with Abaddon removed; large resilience and commander-identity cost.

deterministic_adverse_cases.setup: Four available mana but only one black-producing resource.
deterministic_adverse_cases.conclusion: The sixth change consumes early selection for a sometimes stranded double-black four-drop; 34 unchanged lands does not establish color reliability.

deterministic_adverse_cases.setup: Abaddon removed before Sakashima resolves; no other controlled copy target with the commander ability.
deterministic_adverse_cases.conclusion: Sakashima must not be credited with a second cascade grant absent Abaddon or another controlled copyable Abaddon.

deterministic_adverse_cases.setup: Single Shrine Sanctum sacrificed/destroyed while its first-main trigger is on stack; no Shrine left.
deterministic_adverse_cases.conclusion: A surviving start-of-phase trigger need not generate three-opponent threshold if the last Shrine disappears.

deterministic_adverse_cases.setup: Own turn with three opponents; Sheoldred survives and Wheel resolves seven cards drawn each opponent; no life replacement.
deterministic_adverse_cases.qualification: These 42 losses occur after Wheel was cast; cannot retroactively give Wheel cascade.

deterministic_adverse_cases.conclusion: Do not model Sheoldred as a guaranteed Wheel multiplier.

deterministic_adverse_cases.setup: Mount Doom untapped but less than {1}{B}{R} available.
deterministic_adverse_cases.conclusion: Utility land X3 activation requires three actual mana, tapping the land, and opponent damage not prevented; not a free threshold.

deterministic_adverse_cases.setup: One spell cast this turn under Rule of Law.
deterministic_adverse_cases.conclusion: The source spell may carry triggered cascade but hits cannot be cast as second spells; activated land and preassembled Assault/Neheb routes remain relevant.

deterministic_adverse_cases.setup: Birgi front, Grinning Ignus, Nightscape Familiar, Impact Tremors and payable repeat loop without Rule of Law or removal.
deterministic_adverse_cases.conclusion: Impact adds a new deterministic conversion of payable repeat Ignus casts into all-opponent damage; maintain real physical mana and sorcery timing.

cut_costs.loss: Tapping threshold source plus spell untap potential even without creature ETBs
cut_costs.gain: Creature-entry all-opponent damage conversion with existing Ignus loop and 40K Spawn

cut_costs.loss: Warhammer upkeep card-exile theft and opponent life-loss engine; some exile spells can be cast and trigger other payoffs
cut_costs.gain: Two-mana first-main guaranteed loss only if Shrine survives and stays present

cut_costs.loss: 2-mana early pinger toughness and no optional extra-mana burden
cut_costs.gain: Equivalent noncreature spell ping plus payable Offspring creating second independent trigger source

cut_costs.loss: Nonhand cast mana-value damage 40K engine, independent of Abaddon as long as exile spells available
cut_costs.gain: Abaddon ability replication after entry only, if commander present

cut_costs.loss: One basic red/fetch target and protection against nonbasic hate
cut_costs.gain: Untapped BR fixing and paid X3 nonspell threshold

cut_costs.loss: One-mana cantrip selection and early color smoothing / storm/Breach setup
cut_costs.gain: BB four-mana wheel payoff with life buffer and massive later threshold when uncontested

judgment: The five-swap variant retains a credible faster-mana consistency edge, and removal-heavy tables invalidate Sheoldred's ceiling. Six-swap wheel build retains a meaningful engine and has verified potential, but local-best I cannot truthfully PASS as globally or field-dominating based on deterministic fixtures alone. Proceed to source-aware opponent-pool adjudication and J reproducibility; do not pad swaps.
